$description: Jefferson Kidd tokens beyond the palette, read from the JKidd - DS Figma library (ADhu9noVbgFbtapMZivOHw) on 2026-09-24. The palette and the six scheme modes come from jkxo-tertiary.json next to this file. Scheme role names are camelCase here and --md-sys-color-kebab-case in CSS, as in Figma's code syntax.

postTypes.$description: Post Type collection, one mode per type. Each value names a Scheme role, so a type recolours with the scheme. accent: fills (rail, tick, highlight, swatches). ink: text and thin marks (kicker, arrow, check). onAccent: text set on an accent fill. PROVISIONAL (User, 2026-09-24; CONTENT-SYSTEM.md section 9).

canvas.$description: Card Frame (8:60) Ratio variants. Judge every card at 320px wide (Principle 4).

fonts.$description: Type collection. Display: Special Elite Even, the repaired cut in fonts/special-elite-repaired (User, 2026-10-11). Body: Inter, for running text. Two comic faces for short text only (User, 2026-10-11): lettering is CC Wild Words (Comicraft, paid; loaded from the machine until a webfont licence is bought), then Anime Ace 2.0 BB (Blambot; also loaded from the machine, never bundled), with Comic Neue (OFL) standing in where neither is installed; burst is Bangers (OFL) for loud titles. Mono stays provisional (JKIDD.md decision 1). Lettering and burst aren't in the Figma library yet.

lettering.fallback: "Anime Ace 2.0 BB", "Comic Neue", "Comic Sans MS", cursive

textStyles.$description: Text styles read from Figma. letterSpacing is in percent of the font size, as Figma stores it. Card/Headline and Card/Title exist in the library but haven't been read into code yet.

genres.$description: Genre colours dress a postcard's front and are not the brand palette (POSTCARDS.md section 4; JKIDD.md decision 10). Hex values read from the JKidd - Workbench file (7Q8GN3IPMoM6lhFtIMquya). on names the genre colour used for text set on the fill.

illustrated.$description: The illustrated postcards on the Workbench page (riverboat 63:55, mountain railway 63:64, lunar colony 66:103, Edo bridge 66:85, Venice carnival 68:40): a cream mat, an ink-bordered scene, a location ribbon and a story label. Ribbon text is ink where cream fails 4.5:1 (teal 2.86, sky 2.79, vermilion 3.02, lagoon 3.43); Workbench sets it in cream on every ribbon.

cartoon.$description: The large-letter cartoon fronts (Postcard Image Algo 147:933), for silly days. Inks sampled by clustering the series masters' pixels: western 'Jefferson Kidd' for ink, cream, orange, gold, brown and red; '#Build in Public' frontier for teal and dark teal, which the western master only uses inside its letters. Accent red is a colour, not a ribbon: neither cream (4.00) nor ink (3.6) reaches 4.5:1 on it. The spec's ink library: orange, cream, cyan, teal, brown, black, olive, accent red.
